description: The Montevideo tree census dataset holds the census of the city's trees carried out between 2005 and 2008 by the municipal green areas service. It is published as one CSV file for each of the city's zonal community centres (CCZ), a table of species codes, and a reference text file that explains each field. The municipal catalogue and the national open data catalogue both list it under the Uruguayan open data licence, in the infrastructure group and with the tags trees and census. Access is free with no registration. Caveats: the page warns that work has continued on this base but some of the data is not up to date, which must be taken into account in studies; the census is more than fifteen years old; and the field descriptions are in Spanish. Coverage is the city of Montevideo. It supports green infrastructure planning, urban heat and stormwater studies, and the assessment of tree fall risk to streets and overhead lines in storms; related records are the Buenos Aires trees in green spaces dataset and the Copenhagen street trees dataset.
